name: The Orchid Show 2026: Christian Sampson
blurb: Selby Gardens' signature fall exhibition fills its bayfront conservatory with orchid installations by artist Christian Sampson. Admission is $28 for adults, $12 for ages 5–17, and free for members and kids 4 and under.
photo_credit: Photo: Marie Selby Botanical Gardens / Sarasota Magazine

name: Fright Night on St. Armands
blurb: St. Armands Circle's beloved Halloween tradition turns the island's shopping district into a trick-or-treat route, with costumed kids collecting candy from Circle merchants. Free and family-friendly, just minutes from Lido Beach.

name: Sarasota Farmers Market
address: Lemon Ave & Main St, Sarasota, FL 34236
blurb: Florida's iconic downtown market with local produce, flowers, baked goods and prepared foods. Free to browse, a perfect Halloween-morning stroll through downtown Sarasota before the evening festivities.

name: Siesta Key Drum Circle
hours_label: About 1 hr before sunset (~5:45 PM, clocks fall back) · Free
blurb: A beloved Siesta Key Sunday ritual: drummers, dancers and beachgoers gather on the famous quartz sand to drum the sun down over the Gulf. Free and open to all, just bring a chair or blanket and join in.
